results.name: Nine distinct growth worlds lead from a small mouse to Earth diameter
Corrupt and hostile save shapes become finite bounded playable state
Movement is time based, diagonal-normalized and bounded to the world
Bite respects facing, range, cooldown and one hit per swing
Dash is fast, grants invulnerability and cannot retrigger through cooldown
Enemy windup visibly precedes contact damage and a dash avoids that hit
A giant commits to its warning and cannot be stun-locked by bite spam
Eating food grows the body and recovers health without an action button
Growth cannot skip a live boss; a real bite defeat opens the next world
Breeding requires proximity and inherits exactly one chosen gene per stage
Death and retry preserve inherited genes without allowing another same-world breed
Every growth gate is reachable and the last world ends at Earth scale
Pause freezes state, death can retry the current stage and saves resume safely
